prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with concussion after a sideswipe while changing lanes. The patient had 20 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1464; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a sideswipe collision that occurred during a lane change, with reported head impact and subsequent symptoms consistent with concussion. The mechanism and force of the crash align well with the injury described. Neurological examination and imaging findings clearly support the diagnosis. There is no record of prior injury to the head or neck region. Care was delivered over twenty visits and followed a typical course of concussion management, including symptom monitoring, cognitive and vestibular assessment, graded activity guidance, and gradual return to daily functioning. Visit frequency tapered as symptoms resolved and the patient reached functional recovery. Billing records reflect single, non-duplicated charges for each service rendered. Ongoing precautions were discussed, and the patient was advised to report any recurrence of headache, dizziness, or cognitive difficulty.
